Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : 1. The minimum number of years of General Experience of the tenderer in the works as Contractor shall be Twelve (12) year.
Years in counting backward form the date of tender publication of IFT in e-Gp portal.
2. The minimum specific experience as a Prime Contractor in Survey works of at least 1(One) contract of the minimum value of the
similar nature, complexity and methods/construction technology successfully completed within the last 5(five) years, each with a
value of at least BDT.Tk. 37.00 (Thirty seven) lac. Years counting back ward from the date of publication of IFT in e-Gp portal.
3. The required average annual construction turnover shall be greater than Tk. 110.00 (One crore ten lac) in the last 5(Five) years.
Years counting back ward form the date of publication of Tender Notice/IFT of IFT in the e-gp portal.
4. The minimum amount of liquid assets or working capital or credit facilities tender shall be 28.00 (Twenty eight) lac only.
5. The Tender Capacity is Tk. 51.00 (Fifty one) lac. Supporting document must be submitted along within formation as per
enclosed form(on going works/commitments)
6. The Tenderer must enclose up-to-date Trade license, Income Tax clearance certificate & VAT registration certificate.
7. Personnel Capacity & Equipment Capacity as per TDS.
Brief Description of Works : As-build drawing of KDA's Various installations, Residential plots, Commercial plots, industrial plots, buildings and roads through
digital topographic survey by total station Machine (Package-5). Nibir Residential area, Shiromani Industrial Residential
Area, Miredanga residential area for low income people, Shiromani Industrial Area, KDA Shiromani Market and kacha bazer
market, Commercial near Shiromani Jessore Road including. Construction & Installation of RCC demarcation pillar. Digital
Topographic Survey of 515 acre.
